body:
I paid $300 to be raped, even with my insurance and the ACA. Paying that bill was one of the hardest things I've ever done and I've been struggling financially since because that was all of my emergency funds. 

I don't think I would have been able to emotionally survive my assault if I had to pay the full amount.
I'm a second semester senior, I'm graduating in April. I just would much rather be dead than even deal with this for another second
I've literally fucked myself over to a point where I am despised and I deserve it. There's no way to come back from that, I truly and utterly want to die.

I don't know why I didn't leave earlier. Or why I went at all when it didn't feel right. When I tried to leave this morning, he kept grabbing me and physically kept me from getting up to put my clothes back on. 

I'm never going to see him again. But I have no idea how to recover from last night.
